lines.text: After escaping the terrible curse of Brahmahatya…
Kala Bhairava was finally free.
But his journey was not over.
Lord Shiva had chosen a new destiny for him.
Bhairava would become the eternal guardian of Kashi…
the sacred city of liberation.
A city where even death could lead to freedom…
required a powerful protector.
And that protector would be Kala Bhairava.
From that moment onward…
Bhairava became known as the Kotwal of Kashi…
the divine guardian who watches over the sacred city.
He protects its boundaries…
watches over its devotees…
and ensures that the sacred laws of the city remain unbroken.
His fierce appearance hides a deeper purpose.
He is not merely the destroyer of evil…
but the protector of those who seek liberation.
Even today…
devotees visit the famous Kala Bhairava Temple in Varanasi…
seeking his blessings before completing their pilgrimage.
And so…
the terrifying Bhairava who once carried Brahma's skull…
became the eternal guardian of the city where that very curse was destroyed.
But there is another mystery surrounding Kala Bhairava.
Why is he worshipped as the Lord of Time…
and why does even time itself fear him?
That is the story of our next episode.
